fusions.name: Whole Weight Down
fusions.desc: Lunges up to 3.5 tiles and falls on the target, which deals 30 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. The target is left [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds and moves 30% slower for 4 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Wounded Shrug
fusions.desc: Throws your weight through a cone 2 tiles ahead, which deals 4 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Laid-Up Stores
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 20% for 10 seconds, and you restore 12 health.

fusions.name: Denned Up
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 50%, healing you receive is 40% stronger for 8 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
